oneOf.description: Launch and supervise a persistent adapter process.
Connect to a service or HTTP-backed harness.
Launch and supervise a persistent Python adapter host.
Delegate to a harness-native plugin package.

ControlLocation.description: Where NeMo Fabric control code runs relative to the environment.

oneOf.description: NeMo Fabric runs on the host/control plane and starts or connects to the harness in the environment.
NeMo Fabric runs inside the prepared environment with the harness.

artifacts.description:
Artifact root visible to the harness runtime. For non-local providers this
is an environment-local path and must not be resolved on the host.

control_location.description: Where NeMo Fabric control code runs.

env.description: Environment variables visible to the harness and its tools.

ownership.description: Whether NeMo Fabric owns the environment resource.

workspace.description:
Workspace visible to the harness runtime. For non-local providers this is
an environment-local path and must not be resolved on the host.

EnvironmentOwnership.description: Whether NeMo Fabric owns the underlying environment resource.

oneOf.description: The caller or a surrounding system owns the environment resource.
NeMo Fabric created or leased the environment resource and may release it.

RuntimeInterface.description:
Where to reach one native interface that a runtime serves.

Paths are environment-local. A handle never contains a credential value:
`credential_file` names the owner-only file that holds it, when the
interface has one.

oneOf.description: HTTP interface listening on a loopback address.

address.description: Loopback IP address the interface listens on.

credential_file.description: File holding the interface's credential, when it has one.

port.description: TCP port the interface listens on.

oneOf.description:
Terminal interface that a person opens by running its launcher in the
environment, for example with `openshell sandbox exec --tty`.

credential_file.description: File holding the interface's credential, when it has one.

launcher.description: Executable that opens the terminal UI with the runtime's configuration.

interfaces.description:
Native interfaces this runtime serves, keyed by interface name. Absent
means none. Never contains credential values.

runtime_binding.description: NeMo Fabric-owned opaque binding for this runtime handle.

service_id.description: Service used by this runtime, when it is connected to a shared service.
